title: SDK adoption playbook: triage for language coverage, auth patterns, and streaming ergonomics
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Problem statement:
Customers across SMB and enterprise tiers keep requesting disparate SDK features: additional language bindings, standardized auth adapters (SSO + KMS patterns), and ergonomic streaming APIs. Requests arrive via support tickets, Sales intake, and direct CSM asks. We need a repeatable triage and prioritization playbook to decide what to build, what to gate behind Dedicated/Private, and what to document or prototype instead.

Goals:
- Create a lightweight, repeatable intake + scoring rubric for SDK requests that balances customer impact, implementation cost, security surface, and maintenance burden.
- Prototype a minimal auth-adapter pattern (SSO + token exchange + optional KMS hooks) that can be reused across language SDKs.
- Define a streaming ergonomics guideline (backpressure, cancelation, reconnect semantics, chunk framing) we expect language SDKs to follow.
- Produce an adoption path: Quickstarts + migration notes for enterprise customers and a gating checklist for Dedicated/Private compatibility.

Scope (in):
- Language support triage (prioritization, not full implementation).
- Auth pattern spec and reference JS + Python adapter examples.
- Streaming API ergonomics spec and test harness for conformance.

Out of scope:
- Full implementation of every requested language binding.
- Long-term maintenance SLA for community-contributed SDKs (we will define policy but not implement maintenance contracts).

Proposed intake fields (initial):
- Customer name & tier
- Use case summary and traffic profile
- Required language(s) and urgency
- Security requirements (SSO, BYOK, audit logs, on-prem)
- Expected concurrency and latency SLOs
- Would customer accept workaround (curl + examples)?
- Customer willingness to fund Dedicated or Professional Services

Prioritization rubric (suggested weights):
- Customer impact: 35% (revenue, active roadmap dependency)
- Security/compliance requirement: 25% (requires Private/Dedicated or KMS)
- Engineering cost: 20% (estimated dev + maintenance)
- Reusability/openness: 10% (benefit to broad customer base)
- Time sensitivity: 10% (deadlines/contract clauses)

Deliverables:
- "SDK Adoption Playbook" living doc (Confluence) with intake form, scoring rubric, and decision examples.
- Auth adapter reference: Python + Node minimal libraries + token-exchange pattern repo.
- Streaming ergonomics doc + automated conformance test harness (lightweight load tests and behavior spec).
- Prioritization board template for PMs (Linear + tags) and handoff checklist for Eng.

Acceptance criteria and success metrics included below.
acceptance_criteria: Confluence playbook created and reviewed by ENG, SEC, and DX teams
Scoring rubric applied to the current backlog of 27 SDK requests and priority buckets assigned
Auth adapter repo with documented token-exchange pattern and two example language bindings (Python, Node) in internal repo
Streaming ergonomics doc reviewed by 2 SDK maintainers and passed by conformance harness for JS + Python example clients
Handoff checklist adopted by 2 PMs and an initial intake form linked from Support & Sales playbooks
